def factor_asym_vol_ratio_clean(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'] / df_copy['close'].shift(1) - 1.0
    up_mask = ret > 0
    down_mask = ret < 0
    sq_ret = ret ** 2
    span = 20
    up_var = sq_ret.where(up_mask, 0.0).ewm(span=span, min_periods=span).mean()
    down_var = sq_ret.where(down_mask, 0.0).ewm(span=span, min_periods=span).mean()
    up_vol = np.sqrt(up_var)
    down_vol = np.sqrt(down_var)
    ratio = down_vol / up_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    df_copy['factor_asym_vol_ratio_clean'] = ratio
    return df_copy['factor_asym_vol_ratio_clean']
description: This mutation simplifies the parent by removing the second exponential smoothing on the volatility ratio. The core mechanism remains asymmetric volatility (leverage effect): the ratio of downside to upside volatility using 20-day EWMA variances. Removing the extra smoothing reduces lag and may improve IC while preserving the stable RankIC from the underlying asymmetry signal.
